purpose: CheckLink canonical search-result URLs: keep only parameters that change what results are shown; remove everything else by default.
method: Primary sources first: engine help pages and preference/advanced forms, official API docs, the engines' own apps and front-end bundles, SearXNG engine modules (commit f4822b3fc467), other open-source clients (degoog), filter lists (AdGuard, uBO, DandelionSprout, Brave clean-urls, ClearURLs), plus read-only live GET probes from a VPN egress on 2026-10-10. Items marked inferred are not confirmed by a primary source.
kept_param_order: Tests preserve the original order of kept parameters.

paths: / (result page only when q is present; without q it is the homepage). Applies to duckduckgo.com, www, noai, safe and the onion host
/lite and /lite/ (non-JavaScript lite results; duckduckgo.com/lite and lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/)
NOT result pages: /l/ (outbound redirector, unwrap uddg), /y.js (ad click), /d.js /i.js /v.js /news.js (JSON APIs), /settings, /params, /bang, /ac/

functional.name: q
functional.meaning: Search query (may contain operators such as site:, filetype:, !bangs).

functional.name: kl
functional.meaning: Region for results: xa-ar ... vn-vi, wt-wt = no region (full list on the help page). DuckDuckGo's own settings dictionary describes it as 'Changes the preferred region for search results'.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/settings/params/; https://duckduckgo.com/dist/util/u.9a6f65eb56a1d2e8cbab.js (settings dictionary kl); https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/f4822b3fc46726bb259d14c6332b702c76b98f82/searx/engines/duckduckgo.py; live observation 2026-10-10: kl=de-de turned into bing_market=de-DE in the d.js call

functional.name: kp
functional.meaning: Safe search: 1 = strict, -1 = moderate, -2 = off.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/features/safe-search/; https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/settings/params/; live observation 2026-10-10: kp=-2 became ex=-2 in the d.js call

functional.name: kad
functional.meaning: Display language (interface language) such as en_GB, nb_NO; default wt_WT (browser language). The front end also puts it first when ranking result languages.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/dist/util/u.9a6f65eb56a1d2e8cbab.js (kad: 'Changes the language for elements like buttons, settings, and labels', name 'Display Language'); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/d.bf060419ed940a233888.js (LANGUAGE_KEY:"kad", resultLanguages ordering); https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (bang 'duckgoes' uses kad=es_ES)

functional.name: df
functional.meaning: Date filter: d, w, m, y, or a custom range YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/features/dates/ (feature); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/d.bf060419ed940a233888.js (DDG.Data.HiddenFields DATE_FILTER:"df", Past day/week/month/year ids d/w/m/y); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/g.edb8e6b509facf195f5c.js (custom range built as from..to in ISO dates); https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/f4822b3fc46726bb259d14c6332b702c76b98f82/searx/engines/duckduckgo.py (time_range_dict d/w/m/y); https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (bang 'day' = df=d); live observation 2026-10-10: html.duckduckgo.com form has select name=df with d/w/m/y

functional.name: ia
functional.meaning: Vertical or instant-answer id. Only meaningful as a vertical when the resolved vertical is not web: images (with iax=images), videos (with iax=videos), news (with iar=news), shopping (with iax=shopping), recipes (with iax=recipes), chat (ia=chat opens Duck.ai). ia=web and instant-answer ids (about, calculator, definition, answer, qa, weather, ...) do not change the result set.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/dist/wpm.main.6ef5bbf2bfce334a5036.js (getValidVerticalId: chat if ia=chat; maps_expanded if iaxm; images if ia=images&iax=images or only iar=images; videos likewise; shopping likewise; recipes if ia=recipes&iax=recipes; news if ia=news&iar=news or only iar=news; else web); https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (ddgi ia=images&iax=images, ddgv iar=videos&iax=videos&ia=videos, ddgn iar=news&ia=news, chat ia=chat)
functional.condition: keep only when the resolved vertical is images, videos, news, shopping, recipes or chat; drop when it resolves to web (the owner's test: ia=web is dropped)

functional.name: iax
functional.meaning: Expanded vertical paired with ia (images, videos, shopping, recipes).
functional.condition: keep together with ia when they jointly select images, videos, shopping or recipes (images-tab test keeps ia=images&iax=images)

functional.name: iar
functional.meaning: 'IA requery' vertical rewrite (images, videos, news, shopping). Selects the vertical on its own when ia and iax are absent; required with ia=news.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/dist/d.bf060419ed940a233888.js (HiddenFields IA_REQUERY:"iar"); https://github.com/duckduckgo/Android/blob/develop/common/common-utils/src/main/java/com/duckduckgo/common/utils/AppUrl.kt (VERTICAL_REWRITE = "iar"); https://github.com/duckduckgo/Android/blob/develop/app/src/main/java/com/duckduckgo/app/browser/omnibar/QueryUrlConverter.kt (appends iar for images, videos, news, shopping); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/wpm.main.6ef5bbf2bfce334a5036.js; https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/f4822b3fc46726bb259d14c6332b702c76b98f82/searx/engines/duckduckgo_extra.py (fetch_vqd uses iar=images)
functional.condition: keep when it is the only vertical signal (no ia, no iax) or when ia=news; drop when ia+iax already decide the vertical

functional.name: iaxm
functional.meaning: Maps vertical (values seen: maps, directions). Any non-empty value resolves to the maps vertical.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (bang 'ddgm' = iaxm=maps); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/wpm.main.6ef5bbf2bfce334a5036.js (iaxm -> maps_expanded; switch on maps/directions)

functional.name: iaf
functional.meaning: Image or video filter facets as key:value pairs, e.g. size:imagesize-large (size, colour, type, layout, licence facets exist in the UI). Exact token vocabulary beyond the documented example is inferred.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (bang 'il' = ia=images&iax=images&iaf=size%3Aimagesize-large); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/g.edb8e6b509facf195f5c.js (iaf kept as a hidden field and cleared when leaving images/videos; UI strings for size, colour, layout, licence)

engines.notes: Vertical rule (from DuckDuckGo's own front-end resolver): resolve (ia, iax, iar, iaxm) to a vertical; if it is web, drop all four; otherwise keep only the parameters that participate in the resolution (images/videos/shopping/recipes: ia+iax; news: ia+iar; iar alone when ia and iax are absent; maps: iaxm, plus bbox/strict_bbox; chat: ia=chat). Default-valued functional parameters (kl=wt-wt, kp=-1, kad=wt_WT) may be kept or dropped; keeping is safe. The /l/?uddg= redirector is a wrapper, not a result page: unwrap uddg (ClearURLs redirection rule, https://github.com/ClearURLs/Rules/blob/master/data.min.json). /y.js ad-click links carry ad_provider, ad_domain, click_metadata, iurl, ad_type, vqd (AdGuard/uBO strip them). Non-JS hosts: help page https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/features/non-javascript/ links duckduckgo.com/html and /lite; noai.duckduckgo.com is the same search with AI features off (https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/ai-features/about-noaiduckduckgocom/). DuckDuckGo's front-end bundle URLs are content-hashed and will change; they were read on 2026-10-10. kl, kp, kad, df are also stored as cookies (l, p, ad, df), so a cleaned URL can still render differently for a viewer with saved settings.

engines.notes: Startpage is heavily bot-protected (Anubis proof-of-work, sc code, captcha). A cleaned URL without sc/pl/segment is still the documented search string (https://support.startpage.com/hc/en-us/articles/4520913488148-Search-strings), but some clients and IPs (VPN egress was blocked on 2026-10-10) get the captcha page; issue https://github.com/DandelionSprout/adfilt/issues/582 shows Startpage once blocked trimmed opensearch URLs. Region and family filter are also stored in the preferences cookie (search_results_region, disable_family_filter), so results can differ per viewer. prfe is classed non-functional by default; CheckLink could offer an opt-in to keep it. Live SERP could not be inspected from this network (captcha-block redirect), so qsr and t meanings rest on client code.

functional.name: s
functional.meaning: Start position. API docs: 1 = first result, 11 = first result of page 2 at 10 per page. SearXNG sends s=10 for page 2.

functional.name: t
functional.meaning: Results per page (5 to 40; default 10). Defines the page window together with s.
functional.condition: keep: changes which results appear on the page

functional.name: site
functional.meaning: Restrict to one site.

functional.name: since
functional.meaning: Last-modified since: day, month, year or YYYYMMDD.

functional.name: before
functional.meaning: Last-modified before: day, month, year or YYYYMMDD.

functional.name: datewr
functional.meaning: Date weight ratio; 100 ranks by date.

functional.name: safe
functional.meaning: Safe search: 0 or 1.

functional.name: reg
functional.meaning: Restrict to pages from a region: eu, de, fr, uk (case varies).
functional.source: https://www.mojeek.com/preferences ('Only show search results from this location'); https://www.mojeek.com/advanced.html; https://www.mojeek.com/support/api/search/request_parameters.html

functional.name: arc
functional.meaning: Preferred location for results (ISO country code, none, or auto).
functional.source: https://www.mojeek.com/preferences ('Set the preferred location for search results'); https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/f4822b3fc46726bb259d14c6332b702c76b98f82/searx/engines/mojeek.py (region_param arc)

functional.name: lb
functional.meaning: Preferred language for results (language boost, ISO 639-1).

functional.name: lbb
functional.meaning: Strength of the language boost (1 to 100).

functional.name: rb
functional.meaning: Region boost country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

functional.name: rbb
functional.meaning: Strength of the region boost (1 to 100).

functional.name: lr
functional.meaning: Restrict to a language (beta).

functional.name: si
functional.meaning: Maximum results per domain (0 = unlimited).

functional.name: clufmt
functional.meaning: Clustering format (1 to 5, 0 disables).

functional.name: fi
functional.meaning: Domains to include (comma separated).

functional.name: fe
functional.meaning: Domains to exclude (comma separated).

functional.name: fmt
functional.meaning: Vertical on the web UI: images, news, sst (Substack). On the API the same name selects json/xml output.

functional.name: sst
functional.meaning: Substack tab flag submitted with fmt=sst.

functional.name: foc_t
functional.meaning: Mojeek Focus topic (Cybersecurity, Encyclopedias, Recipes, SmallWeb, TechNews, ...): restricts results to a curated domain set.

functional.name: lang
functional.meaning: Site (interface) language: en, de, fr.

functional.name: imgpr
functional.meaning: Image provider for image results: openverse (default) or pixabay.

nonfunctional.name: theme, hp, autocomp
nonfunctional.meaning: Theme, minimal homepage, autocomplete (Mojeek's own cookieless example strips to these display settings).

nonfunctional.name: qsbu, qsba, qss[]
nonfunctional.meaning: Search Choice buttons/bar and which other engines to list.

nonfunctional.name: date, cdate, size
nonfunctional.meaning: Show last-modified date, crawl date, document size in results.

nonfunctional.name: tlen, dlen
nonfunctional.meaning: Title and snippet length.

nonfunctional.name: rp_i
nonfunctional.meaning: Tidy URL style.

nonfunctional.name: spell
nonfunctional.meaning: Show alternative spelling suggestions (display only; query unchanged).

nonfunctional.name: newtab, ref
nonfunctional.meaning: Open in new tab; referrer protection.

nonfunctional.name: mal, sumb, sumt, ib, tn
nonfunctional.meaning: AI summary box position, summarise button, summary tab, infoboxes, number of news items alongside results.

nonfunctional.name: tab
nonfunctional.meaning: Preferences page tab.

nonfunctional.name: api_key
nonfunctional.meaning: Search API credential; must never survive cleaning.

engines.notes: Mojeek keeps preferences either in a cookie or as URL parameters (cookieless mode), so shared result URLs often carry a full preference set; only the result-shaping ones above should survive. The SERP is behind an ALTCHA proof-of-work captcha (SearXNG mojeek.py), so the web-side behaviour of API-only parameters (rb, rbb, lr, clufmt, fi, fe) could not be confirmed; they are kept as functional because they can only change results. arc and lb are also read from cookies of the same name.
